title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：saving　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 saving 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the shopkeeper ① kept the saving that no buyer in the shop would have counted, and he said the keeping was the whole of the month. The ② saving, meaning the store itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed uncounted in the book; a saving, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ saving in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ saving at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A saving, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the shopkeeper said the counting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the saving was the whole of the matter, meaning the security and not the store. The ⑥ saving, meaning the security and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; saving, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a store and a security. He said the security is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ saving had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ saving of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of counting; saving, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ saving I remember is the store counted in the account, which closed in 1973 and is still counted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ saving, my mother said in 1975, is the only store that improves by being counted; every saving, she said, is a security that has agreed to look like a store. She said the security was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 积蓄；节省（指铺子里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 积蓄；节省（指那笔积蓄本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the saving 存这一笔积蓄
D. n. 积蓄；节省（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 积蓄之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的积蓄之事）
F. n. 积蓄；节省（指账本里写到、被清点的那一笔）
G. n. 积蓄、底气（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 底气（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the saving that no buyer in the shop would have counted
The saving, meaning the store itself and not the scale
the saving at the far counter
the saving was the whole of the matter
the saving had become a line in an account
The saving of the whole thing
A saving, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: keep the saving 意为“存这一笔积蓄”，1966 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯清点的一笔积蓄做了一遍。
saving 意为“积蓄；节省”，指那笔积蓄本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被清点。
saving 意为“积蓄；节省”，指铺子里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
saving 意为“积蓄；节省”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
saving 意为“积蓄、底气”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔底气就是那件事的全部。
saving 意为“底气”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔积蓄，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
saving 意为“积蓄；节省”，指账本里写到、被清点的那一笔，到 1971 年这一笔成了账本里的一行。
saving 意为“积蓄之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的积蓄之事是一处铺子和三个月份的清点。
saving 意为“积蓄；节省”，我记得的是账本里清点过的那一笔，1973 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一笔。
saving 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，积蓄是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的积蓄。
